programs.title: Bing MAIN
programs.desc: Bing & Sula are looking for things to sell in their shop! They find Mr Rainybow! But he hasn’t got his head anymore, so they decide to sell him to a nice lady. But, what happens when they do find his head?

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Fizzy and Suds spot a storm coming! They find out how to spot the signs, explore different types of storms, and watch as thunder, lightning, and rain become sunshine and a rainbow.

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.desc: Grandpa Pig's Computer: Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work - as well as Happy Mrs Chicken. But who will fix it when it breaks?

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Robert Irwin joins The Wiggles for a special rendition of 'Crocodile Hunter' at Australia Zoo, and amidst the rolly-polly fun, Wags' boredom is solved with the help of Dr Dooby-Doo.

programs.title: Shaun the Sheep
programs.desc: The Farmer is stressed out and has had enough of the farm and its inhabitants. He storms off for a break, suitcase in hand, only to reappear almost immediately, the same, but somehow different.

programs.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programs.desc: Team Spidey must get their Dino-Web Crawler back after Rhino steals it.
